reason: This plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness UI extension that adds a dedicated Canvas panel for visual review of HTML prototypes, with local/URL preview and masking tools. Evidence from the package metadata and README consistently describes a tabbed visual workspace and `canvas_preview` actions, so it is best classified as a navigation/board-style plugin surface rather than core coding, data processing, or collaboration tooling.

summaries.zh: dsh-plugin-canvas 为 DeepSeek Harness 新增 Canvas 标签页，用于打开本地或网址 HTML 页面进行可视化查看，并提供模糊遮罩等标注操作。
summaries.en: dsh-plugin-canvas adds a Canvas tab in DeepSeek Harness for visual review of local or URL-based HTML pages, with tools to mask sensitive areas during preview.

capabilities: Loads and previews HTML content from local files and URLs in a plugin tab
Renders previewed web content through an iframe-based sandboxed path
Supports user-controlled blur masking/annotation on rendered pages
Provides a model tool (`canvas_preview`) for render/annotate/clear actions
